subject: Genetics
title: Convergent Evolution
description: A quick, practical guide to Convergent Evolution.

hook.text: Sharks and dolphins look alike but diverged 400 million years ago. Same shape, totally different origin. Why?

buildup.text: Convergent evolution: unrelated species develop similar traits because they face similar environmental pressures.

discovery.text: Eyes evolved independently over 40 times. Flight evolved four times: insects, pterosaurs, birds, and bats.

twist.text: At the molecular level, convergence happens too. Antarctic fish and Arctic fish evolved antifreeze proteins separately.

climax.text: Convergence suggests evolution has limited good solutions. Physics and chemistry constrain biology to repeat patterns.

punchline.text: Nature keeps reinventing the same solutions.

quiz.question: How many times did eyes evolve independently?
